mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP450 enzymes (including CYP3A4) that metabolize disulfiram, reducing disulfiram levels and efficacy; disulfiram may inhibit carbamazepine metabolism leading to potential toxicity.
action: Monitor carbamazepine and disulfiram levels closely; consider alternative anticonvulsant or alcohol deterrent; assess for signs of carbamazepine toxicity (ataxia, diplopia, drowsiness) and disulfiram efficacy loss.
